title: AI APIs & Production — Design for Provider Change
key_insight: Put a narrow adapter around each provider and expose one internal request-result contract. Preserve provider-specific details only where the product truly needs them.
body:
## Design for Provider Change

A provider changes a model version and one response field. Code tied directly to that shape breaks across the product.

Put a narrow adapter around each provider and expose one internal request-result contract. Preserve provider-specific details only where the product truly needs them.

Use idempotency and audit records around side effects. Test fallbacks under real failure modes, because a backup that is never exercised is only a hope.
common_mistakes: API keys are safest inside public browser code.
Every failed request should retry forever.
mini_exercise: Draw “Design for Provider Change” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: AI APIs let products use managed models while keeping credentials, errors, and costs under application control.
explain_back_prompt: Use “Design for Provider Change” to explain AI APIs & Production plainly.
